body.text: EXPEDITION CONTROL HUB FOR OPERATIONS & ENVIRONMENTAL SYSTEMS
> BIOMETRIC VERIFICATION REQUIRED. HARDWARE NOT PRESENT.
> FURTHER DATA REQUIRES DEEPER ARCHIVE ACCESS.
SOURCE: LOCAL UNIT, BATTERY. SHIP NETWORK: NONE
This unit runs on its own battery and is off the ship
network. It has been since the primary cells went out.
Everything in this log was typed by whoever was awake.
The red cases are on the benches in the main bay. The
bay lights went out with the cells, so we are working
by flashlights taped to the ceiling rails.
Four of the ambers are falls from the spokes. People
are trying to reach the hubs on foot, in the dark,
because the lifts have been dead since Day thirty-two.
Eleven intake forms today have no cause of injury on
them. The patients gave one when I asked. I have
written "corridor" on each form and I am leaving it
Day thirty-four of the research phase, by the count the
captain's office started. Nobody has told us to stop it.
> FURTHER DATA REQUIRES DEEPER ARCHIVE ACCESS.
1. The Operations Center closes to all personnel at the
end of this session. No watch will be kept in it.
2. The primary cells have been moved by the Chief
Engineer. Their destination is recorded under his
3. Conditions aboard will be reviewed on Day forty-one of
the phase, stardate 2143.159. If they have not
improved, the pod bays open to all personnel on that
4. The pods hold one hundred and twenty. The ship holds
5. No person is ordered into a pod. No person is ordered
7. Copies are to be posted by hand at every hub and at
the base of every spoke. The ship's address system is
> FURTHER DATA REQUIRES DEEPER ARCHIVE ACCESS.
FILED AS PERSONAL. NOT FOR THE SHIP'S RECORD.
I have known Harlan Cross for eleven years. Tonight he
came to the Operations Center and told me what he means
to do with the cells. He told me as a courtesy, and I
...[CORRUPTED] AND I AM NOT GOING TO WRITE IT HERE...
Dr. Osei came to me on Day thirty. She told me what her
report from Day eighteen had said. By then I did not
That wing has kept its doors closed for as long as this
ship has had programs, and I let this phase keep them
closed like the others. On the first day of it I wrote
that we had everything we needed. I believed it when I
wrote it. I would like that on the record somewhere,
Nearly nine hundred people. One hundred and twenty seats.
I have counted the seats more often than I will say here.
Filing the protocol now. Then I close this room.
> FURTHER DATA REQUIRES DEEPER ARCHIVE ACCESS.

body.text: AUTHOR: DR. AISHA OSEI, RESEARCH TEAM
Baseline for the new phase is done. Same three
calibration sources I have used on this wing for years,
and they agree within tolerance. Cross wants the wing
feed off the shared network for the duration.
Compartmentalized, he says, like the last programs.
Run fourteen of this phase ended early. Cross says the
shielding tripped. The shielding log shows no trip. I have
asked him twice for the record and he has said he will
Filed a supplemental sensor report. Cross says it
belongs to his department. I told the captain the
same when he asked. I am keeping my own copy here,
One workstation in the wing keeps a session open
overnight. No operator is signed in. ECH/OES lists it
as routine. In all my years on this wing no program has
left a session running with nobody at it. The readings
in the shielding change when that session is active. I
cannot tell which is following which.
> FURTHER DATA REQUIRES DEEPER ARCHIVE ACCESS.
FLAGS SET BY ECH/OES. EVERY ENTRY CLASSED ROUTINE.
...is it in the corridor? Is anyone else seeing this...
They are not answering from the forward ring.
It goes out on the schedule like everything else.
Nobody has answered since the second ship docked.
TRANSMITTER DISABLED. POWER SOURCE: LOCAL BACKUP.
> FURTHER DATA REQUIRES DEEPER ARCHIVE ACCESS.
TO: ALL DEPARTMENT HEADS, DSCF CHARON
FROM: VESSEL SYSTEMS INTEGRATION, MARS STATION
Construction of the vessel is complete as of this date.
E.C.H.O.E.S. is commissioned as the single control hub
for the vessel's operations and environmental systems.
From one operating environment, E.C.H.O.E.S. governs
power distribution, atmosphere and water reclamation,
habitat drum rotation, thermal management, the
propulsion command interface, and the Operations Center
terminal network. No department may maintain a separate
Systems checks begin today and run for eleven days.
Department heads will submit all system requests
through the Operations Center. Requests are to cite the
system by its full designation, E.C.H.O.E.S., or by
Each message queue between the vessel and Mars Station
is assigned a reviewer at Mars Station. E.C.H.O.E.S.
queues outbound messages and presents each reviewer's
ISSUED UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF VESSEL SYSTEMS INTEGRATION.
SUBJECT: SYSTEM DESIGNATION IN WORK ORDERS
Work orders that name the system "Echoes" are being
E.C.H.O.E.S. is an initialism and is written with
periods on all forms. On technical forms, use ECH/OES.
A form that writes the name as a word will be returned
The Operations Center acknowledges that the system is
called Echoes aloud, in the corridors and in the mess
hall. That use is tolerated in speech.
EXCERPT. ALL ENTRIES CLASSED ROUTINE BY ECH/OES.
